messages:
Maria (mktg): Heads-up 1: we need social creative + copy variants for the webinar next Tue. Goal: 3 copy variants per segment (X thread short, LinkedIn long-form).
AJ (growth): Which segments are highest priority?
Maria (mktg): Prioritize: 1) Platform eng (latency/cost wins), 2) Data science (benchmarks & evals), 3) SMB devs (ROI / case-study).
Noah (content): I'll produce 3 headline hooks and an X thread (4 tweets max) + an expanded LinkedIn post for each.
Tess (demand gen): We already have creative files: hero GIF + 3 stat tiles in Figma: https://figma.com/s/redwood-webinar-assets (view). Need two crop sizes: X card 1200x675 and LinkedIn 1200x630.
Maria (mktg): For DS copy: lead with the headline claim, then a one-sentence methodology note. Platform copy should mention predictable throughput + autoscale.
Noah (content): Draft DS headline: "Benchmarked: 3x throughput per dollar on real workloads". X short: "3x throughput per dollar 1? Benchmarks and configs in our webinar 17
AJ (growth): CTA split test: Variant A: "Register"; Variant B: "See benchmark + register". Recommend B on LinkedIn, A on X.
Tess (demand gen): Routing rules: LinkedIn signups -> marketing:webinars. X replies containing email -> sales:sdr-inbox. @LeadRouterBot, please add.
LeadRouterBot: Created rule: linkedin_signup -> channel: marketing:webinars; x_reply_with_email -> channel: sales:sdr-inbox. Tags: #webinar_may, source=linkedin|x.
Maria (mktg): Add UTM template: utm_source={source}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may&utm_content={variant}.
Noah (content): LI opener draft: "Benchmarks matter. Deploying LLM features at scale is about predictable latency and cost. Join our webinar to see real customer workloads, configurations, and tradeoffs that cut cost without sacrificing quality.
AJ (growth): Scheduling: X thread Tue 9:00 PT, LinkedIn Tue 10:00 PT. Tess, can you queue these in Sprout and tag variants?
Tess (demand gen): Yep, will queue and post screenshots. I'll also create a dashboard to track clicks to the gated benchmark + email capture rates per segment.
Maria (mktg): Quick experiment: try an influencer partner quote card targeted at DS. Use partner quote about throughput improvements.
Noah (content): Have a beta quote: "Cut token spend ~40% and kept responses tight" 1? I'll format as a pull-quote card.
AJ (growth): Also track downstream: webinar registrant -> email capture -> MQL conversion per segment. Add a widget under marketing->webinars.
Tess (demand gen): Auto-follow for X replies is set: tag and ping #sales-sdr when email found.
Maria (mktg): Great. Please drop final copy + files by EOD. Reconvene tomorrow for final checklist :thumbsup:
